newsitem.title: MEXICO: ELM unit buys 51 pct of Royal Van Namen.
newsitem.headline: ELM unit buys 51 pct of Royal Van Namen.

text.p: DNAP Holdings Corp, a subsidiary of Empresas La Moderna (ELM), has acquired a majority stake of 51 percent in Dutch fruit and vegetable exporting company Royal Van Namen, ELM said on Monday.

The acquisition will allow DNAP Holdings to extend its distribution network of fresh produce to markets in Europe, the Middle East and East Asia, ELM said in a news release. By the same token, DNAP will be able to market Royal Van Namen produce in the United States, Mexico and Canada.
DNAP Holdings arose from the merger between DNA Plant Technology and Bionova, and is listed on Nasdaq.
ELM is based in Monterrey, Mexico, and has three divisions: tobacco, agrobiotechnology and packaging.
